caption: The drawing depicts three views of a loose outer garment, likely a cape or mantle. The top view shows the back of the garment, rendered in detail with grayish-blue and gold tones. The surface is covered with intricate, symmetrical floral and foliate embroidery patterns, radiating from the center and following the contours of the garment's panels and sleeves. Below this are two simple line drawings: the left shows the garment from the front with wide sleeves and an open front; the right shows a side view, highlighting the volume of the sleeve. Both line drawings lack decorative details and only outline the main structural features. The background is a light beige color, and handwritten text at the bottom reads “Westchester County” on the left and “drawn by I. Westtrange” on the right.
title: Embroidered Jacket
